defs.def: located in the north or facing north; connected with or typical of the north part of the world or a region 北方的；向北的；北部的

ex.s: With life in the unforgiving Northern Canada being so demanding, the Inuit’s practical approach to morality made good sense.
ex.t: 鉴于加拿大北部严酷的生活环境如此苛刻，因纽特人务实的道德观很有道理。

ex.s: By the early 1970s, after centuries of cruel and continuous hunting by settlers, 600 to 800 grizzlies remained on a mere 2 percent of their former range in the Northern Rockies.
ex.t: 到20世纪70年代初，经过定居者数百年来残酷而持续的猎杀，灰熊只剩下600到800头，仅分布于北落基山脉昔日活动范围的2%。

ex.s: No area was spared or unaffected, from the foggy northern coast to the Sierra Nevada Mountains to the San Gabriels above Los Angeles.
ex.t: 从雾蒙蒙的北海岸到内华达山脉到洛杉矶上方的圣盖博山，没有哪个地区幸免或未受影响。

ex.s: It runs for several hundred metres on the eastern coast of Northern Ireland.
ex.t: 它绵延数百米，位于北爱尔兰的东海岸。

ex.s: I fell in love with northern WA and have been back six times.
ex.t: 我爱上了西澳大利亚北部，已经回去了六次。

ex.s: The Bernina Express follows a route that runs from Eastern Switzerland to Northern Italy.
ex.t: 贝尔尼纳快车沿着一条从瑞士东部到意大利北部的路线行驶。

ex.s: Li Daoyuan(ca 466-527) was a famous writer and ______of the Northern Wei Dynasty.
ex.t: 郦道元（约466-527）是北魏著名的作家和______。

ex.s: For two years, its people had been deep in a civil war between the slave-owning Confederate Southern States and the “free” Northern States of the Union.
ex.t: 两年来，它的人民深陷一场内战之中，即蓄奴的南方邦联各州与联邦＂自由＂的北方各州之间的战争。
